name: edutex-production
description: Production Edutex platform: AWS, PostgreSQL, Cloudflare and isolated web clients.

scripts.build: node scripts/clean-build-output.ts && npm run build -w @edutex/contracts && npm run build -w @edutex/database && npm run build -w @edutex/auth-web && npm run build -w @edutex/portal-web && npm run build -w @edutex/technician-web && npm run build -w @edutex/api && tsc -p scripts/tsconfig.build.json && npm run build -w @edutex/infra-aws
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @edutex/contracts && npm run build -w @edutex/database && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && tsc -p scripts/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.quality: npm run source:docs && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run build && npm run artifact:check
scripts.deploy:check: npm run deploy:compile --silent && node scripts/dist/deploy-production.js check
scripts.deploy:plan: npm run deploy:compile --silent && node scripts/dist/deploy-production.js plan
scripts.deploy:apply: npm run deploy:compile --silent && node scripts/dist/deploy-production.js apply
scripts.deploy:status: npm run deploy:compile --silent && node scripts/dist/deploy-production.js status
